moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-phrase-line-break, written here): Rule: break at the phrase / clause boundary nearest the middle of the line instead of a fixed character count (study: 74 % vs 21 % preferred); for Vietnamese keep multi-syllable words (e.g. 'thành phố') together via a word list. Motion: the caption (bold, ≤ 20 px in the demo) starts as one line; from 0.45 s each char glides to its two-line slot and resizes, 0.55 s expo.out (cubic-bezier .16,1,.3,1), stagger spread over 0.5 s; merges back 3.85–4.4 s. Loop 4.6 s. Params: điểm ngắt (ranh giới cụm gần giữa) · thời gian tách (0.55 s) · lan (0.5 s).
